title: Steps & tags for readable reports
summary: Structure a checkout test into test.step blocks (like manual test steps) and tag it @smoke and @checkout.
why: Steps show up in the HTML report and the trace viewer, so a failure reads 'pay with a valid card' instead of a bare line number. Tags let CI run subsets: --grep @smoke.
objectives: Assert the confirmation inside the iframe
pitfalls: Putting @smoke only in the title text instead of the tag option.

requires.reason: Wrap the phases in await test.step('…', async () => { … }) so reports read like test steps.

requires.name: tag
requires.reason: Tag the test: test('…', { tag: ['@smoke', '@checkout'] }, async ({ page }) => …).
